releasePurpose: 修正Formal Consumer在Outbox settlement期間誤排全桌背景預測，造成第一輪formal_prediction超過45秒並使前台Final長期落後。
rootCause: Settlement state publication triggered background prediction scheduling before suppressTableUpdateWork was enabled; the explicit finalized-identity prediction then waited for duplicate global scheduler work.

evidence.productionIncident: Raw Final entered DB in 0.5-4.9 seconds while V105 settlements lagged 14-22 rounds and the Outbox plateaued near 160 rows.
evidence.phaseTrace: Attempt 1 stayed in formal_prediction for more than 45 seconds and failed; retry completed in about 1.5 seconds.
evidence.builderBenchmark: 10-table V105 builder completed in 157ms; reconciliation and issuance rollback probes each completed in under 750ms.
evidence.tddRed: Main35 reconciled the finalized identity twice (2 !== 1)
